info.title: Homebrew Tile Hider
info.author: SudoTronics
info.description: Choose homebrew that shows on Wii U Menu
info.details:
An Aroma plugin that pairs with homebrew_on_menu_plugin by Maschell

It opens a overlay menu (opened via a button combo) that lets you enable/disable which homebrew apps appear as tiles in the Wii U Menu.

Usage :

Open the menu with the configured button combo (default L + R + D-Pad Left; changeable in the Aroma config menu under Homebrew Menu Companion).

A toggle the selected app Shown / Hidden
+ hide all apps at once
B close (relaunches the Wii U Menu if changes were made)
Minus rescan the SD card and reload .ignore
L / R jump to top / bottom of the list
